title: Business cases
intro: One transformation business case holds the ten source sections; lighter initiative cases link to it and roll up into it. Amounts are exact decimals in the case currency (SAR by default). Finance validation is a business approval by Finance.
registerIntro: Start with the transformation case. Each initiative case links to it, and the transformation totals count each distinct line once.
emptyBody: Create the transformation business case first; initiative cases link to it.
draftNote: Saved changes are a draft: saving does not submit, fund or approve this business case.
archivedNote: This business case is archived and read-only.

field.title: Title
field.currencyHint: ISO code, for example SAR. Totals are kept per currency; there is no FX conversion.

create.title: New business case
create.description: The case is saved as a draft. Nothing is submitted, funded or approved.
create.levelHint: Create the transformation case first; initiative cases link to it.
create.levelHintExists: This transformation already has its transformation case; a new case is an initiative case linked to it.
create.initiativeHint: Only initiatives without an active business case are listed.

intro.transformation: A transformation case needs all ten sections.
intro.initiative: An initiative case is lighter: sections 1, 4, 5, 6, 7 and 9 are required; the others are optional.

strategic_rationale.title: Strategic rationale
strategic_rationale.hint: Why this change matters now and how it serves the North Star.

baseline.title: Baseline
baseline.hint: The measured starting point with its source. Finance validates it.

value_pools.title: Value pools
value_pools.hint: Quantified upside and downside by driver.

interventions.title: Interventions
interventions.hint: What will change to capture the value.

investment.title: Investment
investment.hint: Summary of the investment; the investment lines below carry the amounts.

benefits.title: Benefits
benefits.hint: Summary of the benefits; the benefit lines below carry the amounts.

timing.title: Timing
timing.hint: Benefit ramp, one-off versus recurring, and the implementation horizon.

risks.title: Risks and sensitivities
risks.hint: Key assumptions, downside case and upside case.

ownership.title: Ownership
ownership.hint: Benefit owner, initiative owner and Finance validator.

decision_ask.title: Decision ask
decision_ask.hint: The funding, policy, resource or prioritization decision needed.

finance.title: Finance validation of the baseline
finance.intro: A business approval recorded by Finance, never by the case author. Editing the baseline afterwards makes the validation Stale; it then no longer counts.
finance.approvalNote: This is a business approval by Finance. It is recorded in your name; it is not a delivery or engineering approval.
finance.staleBody: The baseline changed after Finance validated it. The validation no longer counts until Finance validates the current baseline.
finance.unvalidatedBody: Finance has not validated this baseline yet.
finance.authorCannot: You created this business case, so you cannot validate its baseline (separation of duties).
finance.noBaseline: The baseline section is empty: there is nothing to validate yet.
finance.dialogTitle: Finance validation of the baseline of {{code}}
finance.dialogBody: Record your Finance decision on the current baseline. A later change to the baseline makes it Stale.
finance.editMakesStale: The baseline is validated by Finance. Saving a change to it makes the validation Stale.

totals.title: Totals
totals.intro: Gross benefits, implementation cost and net value are shown separately, per currency. Each distinct line is counted once.
totals.partial: Partial: {{count}} line(s) with unknown amount not included
totals.rollUp: Roll-up of this case and {{count}} initiative case(s), by reference:
totals.ownOnly: An initiative case counts its own lines only.
totals.netNote: Gross benefits minus implementation cost; shown next to both, never instead of them.
totals.netUnknown: Unknown until both gross benefits and implementation cost have a known amount
totals.unknownSide: No line with a known amount
totals.otherWarning: The totals carry a warning; check the lines.

line.title: Line
line.investmentIntro: Capex, opex, internal FTE, vendor cost and opportunity cost. Each line has exactly one class.
line.benefitIntro: Revenue, cost reduction, cost avoidance, working capital and strategic or non-financial benefits. Each line has exactly one class.
line.rollUpNote: These are this case's own lines. Lines of linked initiative cases count in the totals through the roll-up.
line.classHint: Exactly one class per line. The class cannot change after the line is created.
line.valueBasisHint: Only the value bases this class allows are offered.
line.amountHint: Latin digits and a dot, for example 1250000.50. Leave empty when not known yet: it is shown as Unknown, never 0.
line.amountNonFinancialHint: A strategic or non-financial benefit has no amount: it is not monetised without an approved valuation method.
line.formulaHint: A benefit formula can back one active line in the whole transformation, so a benefit is never counted twice.

problems.business_case__line_class_mismatch: This class does not belong to the line kind. Choose one class of the right kind.
problems.business_case__value_basis_mismatch: This value basis does not fit the class.
problems.business_case__non_financial_amount: A strategic or non-financial benefit has no amount: it is not monetised without an approved valuation method.
problems.business_case__formula_already_linked: This benefit formula already backs another active line; one benefit is counted in one line only. Nothing was saved.
problems.business_case__not_initiative_lead: A Workstream Lead edits only the business cases of initiatives they lead.
problems.business_case__amount_negative: A line amount cannot be negative.
problems.business_case__fte_only_internal: FTE applies only to internal FTE investment lines.
problems.business_case__period_range: The period end cannot be before the period start.
problems.business_case__formula_only_benefit: Only a benefit line can be backed by a benefit formula.
problems.business_case__transformation_case_exist: This transformation already has an active transformation business case. Nothing was created.
problems.business_case__initiative_case_exists: This initiative already has an active business case. Nothing was created.
problems.business_case__transformation_case_requi: Create the transformation business case first; an initiative case links to it.
problems.business_case__initiative_required: An initiative business case names its initiative.
problems.business_case__initiative_not_allowed: A transformation business case is not linked to an initiative.
problems.business_case__has_initiative_cases: Archive the initiative business cases linked to this transformation case first.
problems.business_case__baseline_missing: The baseline section is empty: there is no baseline to validate.
problems.business_case__archived: Archived business cases and their lines are read-only.
problems.business_case__already_archived: The business case is already archived.
problems.business_case__revenue_and_margin: This case holds both revenue uplift and margin uplift: check that the same value is not counted twice.
problems.business_case__possible_duplicate: A transformation-level line and an initiative line share class, title and period: possible double count for Finance to resolve.
problems.finance__validator_is_author: Finance validation is done by someone other than the record's author (separation of duties). Nothing was recorded.
problems.validation__fte: Enter FTE as a decimal with up to 2 decimals, for example 2.5.
